name: entret
summary: EMBOSS 6.6.0 'entret': the full text of the entries of a sequence file (or of the entries a query selects) exactly as the sequence readers store it.
short: EMBOSS entret: the text of the entries of a sequence file (any input format of seqret, a query, a range, a list file or a database) as the readers store it; equals entret 6.6.0 on 756 runs.
description: EMBOSS 6.6.0 entret: the entries of a sequence file (any input format of seqret) are read with the text of every entry stored, and the text of each entry is returned exactly as the file has it. sequenceValue is the USA of the program: a query on the file (file:id, file:acc:value, file:wild*, file{a|b}), a range, a list file or a database defined in definitions (db:id); firstOnly stops after the first entry. Equals the installed program on 756 runs (every input format, damaged files, queries).

text: The text of the output file: the entries as the readers stored them.
messages: What the library printed (warnings and errors).

errors: Unable to read sequence ... (no entry matched the query or the file has no sequence)
An input on which the reference program never stops or dies by a fault is refused

example.title: One entry of a two-entry FASTA file
example.prompt: Retrieve the entry s2 from this FASTA file.
example.note: The query file:id keeps the entries whose identifier matches; the text is the lines of the entry as read.
